list.name: Changes
list.comment:
"Initial commit: add browser URL blocker application" - "Add WPF MVVM application for managing Chrome and Edge URLBlocklist policies.
- Add modern WPF user interface - Add Chrome and Edge policy previews - Add URL blocklist add and delete functionality - Add Chrome and Edge restart options - Add browser policy and registry services - Add dependency injection and Generic Host configuration - Add appsettings.json configuration - Add Chrome, Edge, and application icons - Add README documentation - Add .gitignore for .NET and JetBrains Rider"
